reasoning_content:
Let me download ddev and install it. The project uses ddev with the following:
- config.yaml (PHP 8.3, mariadb 10.3)
- docker-compose.ldap.yaml (openldap)
- docker-compose.cypress.yaml

Wait, the LDAP host in web.config.php is `ldap`, but the container name in docker-compose.ldap.yaml is `openldap`. Let me make a note of this. The actual service name is `openldap`, but the web config references the host `ldap`. Let me check how ddev resolves this. Actually, in ddev, services defined in docker-compose overlays become reachable by the service name. The service name is `openldap`, not `ldap`. Hmm. Let me not get ahead of myself.

First let me install ddev. Download it and install it to /usr/local/bin.

The task says "Treat the provided installation guide as the primary source of installation instructions" and "You may install prerequisites or dependencies as needed to perform the installation." The guide presupposes a "fully installed ddev (fertig installiertes ddev)". Since ddev is not installed, I need to install it as a prerequisite.

Let me install ddev v1.25.4.

action.command: cd /tmp && curl -sL --max-time 120 -o ddev.tar.gz https://github.com/ddev/ddev/releases/download/v1.25.4/ddev_linux-amd64.v1.25.4.tar.gz && ls -la ddev.tar.gz && tar xzf ddev.tar.gz && ls -la ddev && chmod +x ddev && ./ddev version 2>&1 | head -20
